title: Fuzzy Wuzzy
subtitle: Fricatives F, Z & W
description: This exercise targets the /f/, /z/, and /w/ sounds in quick succession, training the transitions between labiodental fricatives, alveolar buzzing, and lip-rounded glides. The contrast between voiced /z/ and voiceless /f/ is especially important.
tip: For /f/, gently rest your upper teeth on your lower lip and blow. For /z/, buzz like a bee with your tongue tip near the upper gum ridge — feel the difference in vibration.
phrases: Fuzzy Wuzzy wasn't fuzzy, was he?
Five frantic frogs fled from fifty fierce fishes.
The fuzzy philosopher philosophized about fizzing frozen fizz.
Wolves with wet whiskers whistled while wading in weedy water.
